a1-unit-32.32.1 Lunch:
Narrator: It's December in Chicago. Tom calls his sister Kate. He wants to have lunch with her before Christmas.
Kate: Hello?
Tom: Hi Kate! It's Tom. Let's have lunch together this week. Are you very busy?
Kate: I'm always busy in December, but let me look at my planner. What are you doing this weekend?
Tom: I'm free on Saturday.
Kate: Sorry, I'm going to clean the bakery on Saturday, and that takes all day. And on Sunday I'm having brunch with Lucy at eleven.
Tom: That's OK. I can't do Sunday anyway. I'm going to watch the Bears game with some friends.
Kate: So what about Friday? I'm going to make pizza in the evening, but I'm free for lunch.
Tom: Sorry, I'm taking my Portuguese exam on Friday at eleven.
Kate: Your Portuguese exam? Good luck! Well, I'm free for lunch on Monday or Tuesday.
Tom: Oh no, I'm not. I'm going to go jogging on Monday at lunchtime, and on Tuesday I'm seeing the dentist at half past eleven. What about Wednesday?
Kate: No, sorry. I'm meeting a new supplier at one o'clock. But I'm not doing anything on Thursday.
Tom: Thursday is perfect for me too! Where do you want to go?
Kate: Let's go to City Coffee. Lucy says they have a great new sandwich.
